chef.name: Antoine Laurent
chef.title: Two-Michelin-Starred Executive Chef & Culinary Director
chef.tagline: Reimagining classical French gastronomy through biodynamic terroir, wild foraging, and ancestral fermentation.
chef.bio: Chef Antoine Laurent trained under legendary masters in Lyon and Tokyo before establishing Maison Laurent. Honored with Two Michelin Stars and a Green Star for Sustainable Gastronomy, Antoine bridges precise technique with respectful stewardship of seasonal agriculture.

tastingMenu.dish: Heirloom Beet Tartare & Smoked Creme Fraiche
tastingMenu.ingredients: Salt-baked golden beets, pickled mustard seed, foraged oxalis, elderflower reduction
Braised sea lettuce, vin jaune emulsion, chanterelle mushrooms, sea herbs
Black garlic puree, glazed sunchokes, roasted sour cherries, jus de canard
Crispy sourdough tuile, bay leaf infused olive oil gelato, cocoa nib crunch

philosophy.desc: Menus evolve weekly based strictly on daily harvests from our 4-acre biodynamic farm.
Deepening complexity through house-inoculated garums, lacto-fermented fruits, and artisanal vinegars.
Every peel, bone, and stem is repurposed into reductions, infused butters, and natural dining ceramics.

press.quote: Chef Laurent achieves pure harmony on the plate. His delicate balance of acidity and deep savoriness is a masterclass in modern French cuisine.
An unforgettable dining sanctuary. Antoine's line-caught turbot alone warrants a transatlantic pilgrimage.
